name: Ayşe Demir
bio:
Ayşe Demir's path to motorsport security began unexpectedly during her university days. While studying engineering at Istanbul Technical University, she volunteered at a local rally event as a marshal, quickly recognizing vulnerabilities in crowd control and vehicle security. This sparked a passion for ensuring safety in high-stakes environments.

After graduating, Ayşe pursued certifications in security management and risk assessment, combining her engineering knowledge with practical skills. She worked her way up from smaller regional races to securing national touring car championships, developing a reputation for meticulous planning and decisive action. Her approach to security is proactive and preventative, emphasizing comprehensive threat analysis and robust security protocols. Ayşe is known for her calm demeanor and ability to maintain order even in the most chaotic situations, earning her the respect of both her team and race organizers.

What sets Ayşe apart is her blend of technical expertise and interpersonal skills. She can analyze security systems with the eye of an engineer while effectively communicating with staff and spectators to ensure everyone's safety and cooperation.

physical.hairStyle: long, wavy hair usually pulled back into a practical ponytail
physical.description: Ayşe is of average height with a strong, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with security checklists.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a pre-race security briefing, no matter how small the event.
